fields.Name: T131 - Admin Developer Tools
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Developer Tools section opens an inspector (such as Class Registry or Event Monitor) that renders without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click one of the inspector sub-sections - for example 'Class Registry' or 'Event Monitor'. The success state is that inspector rendering its content (such as a list of registered classes or a live event feed). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the inspector to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Developer Tools section open and a left sub-navigation listing inspectors such as Class Registry and Event Monitor
One inspector sub-section (e.g. Class Registry or Event Monitor) is selected and its content is rendered in the main panel
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
